svelte.reason: The floor sv create's minimal template ships, so a vela project and a plain SvelteKit one start alike.

croner.reason: 11.0 is a major; the cron matching in the workflows runtime has not been checked against it.

openworkflow.reason: openworkflow 0.11 requires Node >=22.22, and a project's floor is 22.17 with engine-strict on, so the install fails on Node 22.17 to 22.21 (verified 2026-11-11). Lift together with the Node floor; openworkflow-pocketbase 0.2 peers openworkflow ^0.11 and moves with it.

openworkflow-pocketbase.reason: Peers openworkflow ^0.11.0, which is held: it requires Node >=22.22 and a project's floor is 22.17.

tailwind-variants.reason: 4.0 is a major; the shadcn-svelte components and the templates' own tv() calls have not been checked against it.

typescript.reason: TypeScript 7 (the native port) is outside @sveltejs/kit's peer range (^6.0.0) and breaks the install. Blocked upstream: lift once Kit admits 7.
